column1: # STATUS: LIVE, 2026-11-23. Case table of the nvbandwidth row (docs/design/V3_OPEN_LANES_NVBW_LLAMAVK_LHM.md).
# One test case of the pinned nvbandwidth (pins.env OPENROWS_NVB_COMMIT, `nvbandwidth -l`) per line, tab separated: id, class, min_gpus.
#   class     ce = copy engine (cuMemcpyAsync), sm = copy kernel on the SMs, latency = pointer-chase kernel (ns, lower is better), local = device-local copy
#   min_gpus  the number of GPUs the test needs: nvbandwidth waives a test that needs accessible peer pairs on a machine without them (source:
#             Testcase::filterHasAccessiblePeerPairs). The machine's own answer decides the expectation; no die, family or driver is named here.
# A test that needs one GPU and is waived is a FAIL (unexpected_waive); a test that needs two and passed on one is a MISMATCH.
# test_open_lanes.py pins this table to the 35 non-multinode testcases of the pinned source.
